evidence_plan.requirement: Inspect model to see if it learned to associate image parts with words related to entities

payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model uses visual contexts to improve its predictions of named entities, suggesting it inspects associations between image parts and words.

claims.text: The model inspects associations between visual contexts and words to improve predictions of named entities.
Visual contexts help disambiguate tokens related to entities, indicating the model's learning process involves image parts.
The modality attention module enhances the model's ability to handle unseen tokens by leveraging visual information.
